# Independent legacy CG sampling controls

These three synthetic .comp projects were generated by engine/tests/mac_probes.rs and exported by Compositor for Mac 1.2.10 during the original resampling investigation. They contain only generated patterns and gray masks. Files are copied into this explicit fixture set; the original untracked return files are preserved.

They cover a 25-degree rotated 300% image, a 65% reduction, and a 400% affine mask. New 1.4.5 source-reference and actual application controls are required separately before Phase 3.5d acceptance. These legacy controls alone do not close that acceptance gate.
